label: Linear Algebra
description: Vectors, matrices, eigenvalues, and linear transformations — the mathematical substrate of neural networks and AI.

label: Probability and Statistics
description: Distributions, inference, Bayes' theorem, and statistical reasoning — required for understanding model training and evaluation.

label: Calculus and Optimization
description: Derivatives, gradients, chain rule, and optimization landscapes — the foundation of learning algorithms.

label: Gradient Descent
description: Iterative optimization via first-order gradients. The core learning algorithm behind neural networks.

label: Backpropagation
description: Efficient computation of gradients through a neural network using the chain rule. Required to understand how networks learn.

label: Neural Network Basics
description: Layers, activations, loss functions, and forward/backward passes in a feedforward network.

label: Sequence Modeling
description: Modeling ordered data — text, time series, code. From RNNs and LSTMs through the transformer revolution.

label: Attention Mechanism
description: Scaled dot-product attention: how a model learns to weigh different positions in a sequence when producing each output.

label: Transformer Architecture
description: The encoder-decoder architecture based on multi-head self-attention. The dominant paradigm for language, vision, and multimodal models.

label: Pretraining Objectives
description: Self-supervised objectives for training language models: next-token prediction, masked language modeling, contrastive learning.

label: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
description: The process of aligning a language model to human preferences using a reward model trained on human comparisons.

label: Constitutional AI
description: Anthropic's technique for training AI systems to be helpful, harmless, and honest using a set of principles (a 'constitution') without solely relying on human feedback.

label: Interpretability
description: Methods for understanding what a neural network has learned — from saliency maps to circuit analysis.

label: Mechanistic Interpretability
description: Reverse-engineering neural networks at the level of circuits and features to understand how specific computations are implemented.

label: LLM Prompting
description: Techniques for eliciting desired behavior from language models: zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and structured prompting.

label: Tool Use in LLMs
description: Function calling, tool schemas, and structured output — enabling language models to invoke external APIs and code.

label: Agent Loop
description: The perceive-think-act-observe loop that enables autonomous multi-step task completion by an LLM-based agent.

label: Memory and Context in Agents
description: Short-term context window, long-term memory stores, retrieval-augmented generation, and episodic memory in AI agents.

label: Kepler's Laws of Planetary Motion
description: The three empirical laws describing the motion of planets: elliptical orbits, equal areas in equal times, and the orbital period relationship.

label: Newtonian Gravity and Two-Body Problem
description: Newton's law of universal gravitation and the analytical solution to the gravitational two-body problem.

label: Orbital Elements
description: The six Keplerian orbital elements (semi-major axis, eccentricity, inclination, RAAN, argument of perigee, true anomaly) used to uniquely define an orbit.

label: Delta-v Budget
description: The total velocity change required for a mission profile. The fundamental currency of spaceflight planning.

label: Tsiolkovsky Rocket Equation
description: The fundamental equation relating delta-v, exhaust velocity, and mass ratio. Defines the limits of chemical propulsion.

label: Specific Impulse (Isp)
description: A measure of propellant efficiency — the thrust produced per unit of propellant consumed per second.

label: Hohmann Transfer Orbit
description: A two-impulse elliptical maneuver used to transfer between two circular orbits with minimum delta-v.

label: Systems Engineering
description: The discipline of designing and managing complex systems across their lifecycle, including requirements, interfaces, verification, and validation.

label: Hallmarks of Aging
description: The molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying biological aging, as defined by Lopez-Otin et al. (2013, 2023): genomic instability, telomere attrition, epigenetic alterations, etc.

label: Epigenetic Clocks
description: Biological age estimators based on DNA methylation patterns (Horvath, GrimAge, DunedinPACE). Used to measure biological aging rate.

label: Neuroplasticity
description: The ability of the nervous system to reorganize its structure, function, and connections in response to experience.

label: Neuron Anatomy and Physiology
description: Structure and function of neurons: dendrites, soma, axon, myelin sheath, and synaptic terminals.

label: Action Potential
description: The electrical impulse generated by a neuron when it fires: depolarization, repolarization, and refractory period.

label: Working Memory
description: The cognitive system responsible for temporarily holding and manipulating information for use in ongoing tasks.

label: Jobs to Be Done (JTBD)
description: A theory of innovation: customers hire products to fulfill a job — a functional, social, or emotional progress they seek to make.

label: Product-Market Fit
description: The degree to which a product satisfies a strong market demand. The critical threshold between searching and scaling.

label: Content Leverage
description: The mechanism by which written, audio, or visual content creates compounding distribution and audience at near-zero marginal cost.

label: Network Effects
description: The phenomenon where a product or service becomes more valuable as more people use it. A primary driver of startup moats.

label: Unit Economics
description: The revenue and costs attributable to a single unit of business (LTV, CAC, gross margin, payback period).

label: Distributed Consensus & State Machine Replication
description: Algorithms and protocols (Raft, Paxos, Multi-Paxos) that allow multiple nodes to agree on state and transition history in the presence of network partitions and failures.

label: Replication, Sharding & Partitioning
description: Techniques for distributing data across multiple storage nodes for fault tolerance, high read/write throughput, and horizontal scalability.

label: ACID vs BASE & Consistency Models
description: Comparison between strict ACID transactional consistency and BASE (Basically Available, Soft state, Eventual consistency) distributed models.

label: Domain-Driven Design & Bounded Contexts
description: Architectural methodology that models software directly after domain logic, isolating models inside Bounded Contexts with explicit Ubiquitous Language.

label: Dependency Inversion & Clean Architecture
description: High-level business policies and protocols must never depend on low-level UI, database, or framework implementation details; both must depend on abstractions.

label: Design Token Systems & Aesthetic DNA
description: Centralized semantic variables representing colors, spacing, typography scales, shadows, and animation curves that synchronize across all code surfaces.

label: Anti-Slop Design Standards & Visual QA
description: The strict enforcement of high data-ink ratio, typographic elegance, real vector assets, and authentic UI layouts to prevent AI visual degradation.

label: Custom WebGL Shader Materials & Liquid Glass
description: GLSL vertex and fragment shaders that create dynamic refractive glass, volumetric lighting, and organic particle fluid dynamics.

label: Physics-Based Spring Motion & Micro-Interactions
description: Fluid user interface animations driven by stiffness, damping, and mass curves rather than linear durations.

label: The Monomyth & The Hero Journey
description: The universal 17-stage archetypal story pattern of Departure, Initiation, and Return foundational to human storytelling.

label: Secondary Belief & Sub-creation
description: Tolkien doctrine where worldbuilders construct internally consistent Secondary Worlds that command genuine reader belief and emotional truth.

label: The Ten Gates Progression & Guardian Hierarchy
description: The canon initiation path of Arcanea, ascending through Foundation, Flow, Fire, Heart, Voice, Sight, Crown, Star, Cosmic, and Source.

label: Alchemical Frequencies & Element Resonances
description: The sonic, chromatic, and elemental correspondences assigned to each Gate (396Hz Earth through 963Hz Celestial Light).

label: Arcanean Origin Classes & Character Archetypes
description: Character archetypes defining innate elemental affinity, resonance paths, and capability trees in the Arcanea universe.

label: Video-as-Code & Programmatic Motion
description: Composing deterministic video sequences, dynamic overlays, subtitles, and transitions using React components and frame-accurate timeline state.

label: Parametric Spring Physics in Video Composition
description: Using spring physics to drive dynamic title cards, particle explosions, and layout shifts inside Remotion frames.

label: Generative Audio Arrangement & Dynamic Stem Progression
description: Structuring musical compositions through intro, buildup, drop, chorus, and atmospheric outro with harmonic frequency separation.

label: 7 Powers Economic Moats & Durability
description: Creating durable business defenses through scale economies, network effects, counter-positioning, switching costs, brand power, cornered resources, and process power.

label: Convexity, Barbell Strategy & Via Negativa
description: System design that removes fragility and downside risks while maintaining uncapped upside exposure across autonomous agent ventures.

label: The Closed-Loop Content Factory Flywheel
description: Autonomous publishing pipeline where deep research compiles into articles, prompt books, social clips, and digital products, with learning loops improving quality weekly.

label: Prompt Architecture & Knowledge Monetization
description: Transforming battle-tested prompt systems, evaluated playbooks, and agent skills into high-ticket enterprise products and prompt books.

label: Cellular Senescence & Senolytics
description: The irreversible growth arrest of cells accompanied by a senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), a primary hallmark of biological aging.

label: Synaptic Plasticity & Memory Consolidation
description: The biochemical and structural strengthening of synaptic connections through LTP and sleep-mediated replay in the hippocampus and neocortex.

label: Synaptic Transmission & Neurotransmitters
description: The process by which neurotransmitters are released by the presynaptic neuron and bind to receptors on the postsynaptic cell to propagate electrical signals.

label: Sleep Architecture & Cognitive Function
description: The alternating cycle of NREM (slow-wave sleep) and REM sleep that enables metabolic waste clearance via the glymphatic system and emotional calibration.

label: Modular Typographic Scales & Mathematical Harmony
description: Deriving font sizes from a fixed base size and geometric ratio (Major Third 1.25, Perfect Fourth 1.333, Golden Ratio 1.618) to ensure harmonic proportional hierarchy across screen sizes.

label: Baseline Grids & Vertical Rhythm
description: Aligning text baselines to a regular vertical increment (typically 4px or 8px) so paragraphs, headings, blockquotes, and images conform to a continuous rhythmic cadence.

label: The Aesthetic-Usability Effect
description: Users perceive aesthetically pleasing designs as more usable, forgiving minor usability hurdles and experiencing higher emotional trust and task satisfaction.

label: Micro-Interactions & State Feedback
description: Subtle single-purpose animations, hover states, button compressions, and loading pulses that acknowledge user intent and provide immediate kinetic feedback.

label: Brand DNA Matrix & Modernist Restraint
description: The core semantic guidelines defining typography, palette ratios, geometry, voice, and negative space that keep all sub-products visually locked to brand identity.

label: Vector-First Asset Architecture
description: Building all icons, badges, logos, and UI decorations as clean resolution-independent SVGs with direct CSS stroke and fill controls, eliminating bitmap pixelation.

label: Topical Authority & Semantic Entity Graphs
description: Structuring content to exhaustively cover a domain through interrelated entity nodes, demonstrating subject-matter depth to search engines and ranking algorithms.

label: Information Gain Scoring & Original Research
description: Maximizing the net-new data, proprietary benchmarks, and primary evidence provided in content relative to what already exists in search engine indexes.

label: Programmatic SEO & Template Scalability
description: Generating thousands of indexable, high-utility landing pages dynamically from structured databases (e.g. tool registries, prompt libraries, comparison matrices).

label: Pillar-Cluster Content Architecture
description: Organizing website content around comprehensive high-level pillar guides that bidirectionally link to specialized sub-topic cluster articles.

label: Headless MDX Publishing & Code-First Content
description: Authoring articles in Markdown with embedded interactive React components, syntax-highlighted code blocks, KaTeX math rendering, and automated RSS/Sitemap generation.

label: Eugene Schwartz Market Sophistication Stages
description: The 5 evolutionary stages of market awareness and skepticism that determine whether copy must focus on simple claims, expanded claims, unique mechanisms, or brand identification.

label: Direct-Response Copywriting & The 4 U's
description: Persuasive sales writing focused on measurable response and immediate conversion using the 4 U's formula (Urgent, Unique, Ultra-specific, Useful) and proof stacking.

label: Organic Social Distribution Loops
description: Designing self-reinforcing content mechanisms where social posts drive newsletter subscribers, who share insights, triggering algorithmic amplification without paid ad spend.

label: Scroll-Stopping Visual & Textual Hooks
description: Opening 3 seconds or headline frames designed to disrupt timeline complacency through cognitive dissonance, counter-intuitive data, or high-contrast imagery.

label: The Cross-Platform Social Flywheel
description: Repurposing deep-dive long-form essays into X threads, LinkedIn carousel decks, YouTube shorts, and newsletter digests to maximize content ROI across algorithms.

label: Hormozi Grand Slam Offers & Value Equations
description: Constructing unbeatable product offers that combine high dream outcomes, proven guarantees, effortless speed, and unmatchable bonuses to eliminate price competition.

label: Value Ladder Architecture & Customer Ascension
description: Structuring digital products across price tiers: Lead Magnet (Free) -> Tripwire ($27-$97) -> Core Course ($497-$997) -> Sovereign Advisory ($5k-$25k).

label: Video Sales Letter (VSL) Funnels
description: High-converting single-page sales funnels driven by an 8-15 minute structured video narrative using the Epiphany Bridge and one-click checkout.

label: Lifecycle Email Sequences & Soap Opera Dramas
description: Automated trigger-based email flows (Welcome Soap Opera, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase Onboarding, Evergreen Re-engagement) that nurture leads on autopilot.

label: Margin of Safety & Downside Protection
description: The fundamental principle of investing: demanding an entry price significantly below conservative intrinsic value to insulate against forecasting errors and unexpected panics.

label: Circle of Competence & Mental Latticework
description: Charlie Munger doctrine of operating strictly within the boundaries of businesses and technologies you understand intimately, ignoring opportunities outside your circle.

label: Intrinsic Value & Discounted Cash Flows
description: Calculating the true underlying value of a business by estimating its future owner earnings and discounting them back to the present with an appropriate risk rate.

label: Second-Level Thinking & Contrarian Edge
description: Howard Marks framework of evaluating not just the immediate consensus view, but what the consensus has already priced in, identifying mispriced asymmetries.

label: Macro Credit Cycles & Deleveraging Mechanics
description: Ray Dalio template of tracking central bank interest rates, debt-to-income ratios, liquidity expansions, and beautiful deleveragings to navigate asset bubbles.

label: The Sovereign Barbell Capital Allocation
description: Allocating 80-90% of assets into hyper-safe, liquid, inflation-resistant sovereign stores of value, and 10-20% into asymmetric, convex, highly scalable venture bets.

label: Permissionless Leverage (Code, Media & Swarms)
description: Naval Ravikant framework of building non-linear wealth by deploying software algorithms, digital media content, and autonomous AI agents that work 24/7 without permission.

label: The Autonomous Sovereign Wealth Engine
description: A self-sustaining loop where cashflow from agentic digital products is automatically swept into hard assets, research grants, and compute capacity, compounding sovereign freedom.

label: Hierarchical OS-Style Agent Memory Paging
description: Treating the LLM context window as RAM and external stores (SQLite/Vector DB) as virtual memory disk, paging context in and out via explicit OS-style memory operations (MemGPT paradigm).

label: Bi-Temporal Knowledge Graphs & Fact Lifecycles
description: Tracking both the Valid Time (when a fact was true in reality) and the Transaction Time (when the knowledgebase recorded the fact) to prevent historical contradictions and model hallucinations.

label: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) Hybrid Search
description: Combining BM25 keyword search ranks with dense vector cosine similarity ranks using the formula RRF_Score = sum(1 / (k + rank_i)) to achieve superior retrieval accuracy across code symbols and conceptual queries.

label: Episodic Reflection & Verbal Reinforcement Buffers
description: Storing detailed execution trajectories and self-reflective post-mortems in an episodic buffer, allowing agents to learn from past errors across sessions without retraining model weights (Reflexion paper).

label: Sleep-Time Dreaming & Memory Consolidation
description: An automated nocturnal background process that replays recent agent interaction traces, extracts durable heuristics, prunes stale working memory, and compiles new knowledge graph nodes (The Starlight Dreaming Engine).

label: MCP 2.0 Resource URI Grounding & Zero-Bloat Hydration
description: Exposing knowledge graph nodes as standard Model Context Protocol Resource URIs (starlight://books/{id}, starlight://nodes/{id}) allowing agents to pull exact citation passages on demand rather than bloating system prompts.

label: Maker ≠ Checker Adversarial Convergence
description: The strict governance principle that an agent which produces code or strategy can never be the sole verifier of its own output; an independent adversarial model from a different family must critique and reach consensus before ship.

label: Permissionless Agent Services & Micro-Settlement
description: Autonomous agents executing specialized micro-tasks (SEO audit, image rendering, code review, newsletter compilation) and settling value autonomously via programmable payment rails.

label: Token Rate-Limit Sharding & Key Pools
description: Distributing high-concurrency swarm calls across multiple API keys, service tiers, and regional endpoints using token-bucket rate limiting to prevent 429 throttles during peak swarm bursts.

label: Memory Guardian & WSL2 OOM Prevention
description: Standing telemetry process that continuously samples system RAM, VRAM, and swap usage. When free memory drops below critical threshold (50GB free / 15% RAM), it throttles parallel agent worktrees and enforces text-only modes to prevent OS lockups.

label: Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) at Scale
description: Next.js architecture pattern that pre-renders key hub routes at build time while lazily generating and caching long-tail pages (10,000+ domain/concept paths) on first request, background revalidating stale caches without full site rebuilds.

label: Entity Resolution & Automated Graph Deduplication
description: Automated identity resolution using normalized string distance (Levenshtein/Jaro-Winkler) combined with dense embedding cosine similarity (>0.92) to detect duplicate authors, papers, or tools ingested from divergent sources and merge them into canonical SSOT nodes.

label: Columnar Disk-Backed Vector Storage (LanceDB)
description: Serverless, embedded vector search engine built on the Lance columnar data format. Allows zero-daemon, sub-millisecond similarity search over millions of vector embeddings directly on local disk or S3/cloud storage without running heavy database servers.
